title: Selection and Paper runtime_config can still change trading behavior without mandatory version activation
description: Expected: Any runtime choice that can affect selected stocks, target positions, order intents, fills, cash, holdings, NAV, or performance must be represented by a versioned platform runtime profile, validated execution policy activation, tail policy version, or PackageRuntimeRelease/PortfolioBindingVersion. Selection Center, Paper v2, and MiniQMT must persist the exact version/hash used for every run and should reject unversioned raw runtime_config behavior changes outside explicitly diagnostic/read-only preview paths. Actual: Selection Center and Paper v2 can still accept raw runtime_config/top-level legacy keys that alter behavior without requiring a profile version/activation.
required_verification: Production-like Selection/Paper/MiniQMT execution paths reject unversioned runtime_config keys that change trading behavior.
Versioned runtime profile activation records are persisted and copied into every selection/paper run context.
Preview/diagnostic flows, if any, are explicitly marked non-trading and cannot submit orders or mutate durable ledgers.
closure_requirements: Runtime behavior changes require profile/policy/release version references and hashes.
Legacy top-level runtime keys cannot silently bypass activation in trading execution paths.
